note: Lesson is the make-X/get-X verb drill (7ammas, wajja3, daaya2, 7arrak). Two traits matter for the merge: (1) Amal types EVERY target sentence in chat as the model answer, right or wrong, so a chat line that differs from his words is the only signal for several rows - I kept those as chat-fix per the reader brief but confidence stays low/medium; (2) the ASR writes 7 as h and often drops a final ha/hamza, so several r2 'recast' rows are S4 (D24, D25, D26, D29). Two clear Amal fixes appear in disputed windows but were not themselves disputed - merger please confirm they are in the agreed set, else add: (a) 06:28-06:37 grammar: he said roughly 'ana lazim tseer' for 'I must make her become', Amal: 'أنا لازم تصير؟ No. You'd need something like to make her, to let her become' -> a5alliha t9eer (chat 07:04), signal explicit-no; (b) 19:23 vocab-A tier 1: 'fi el shara' (shaare3 = street) for 'on the road', Amal 19:29 'street. What's the road?' -> he 19:36 '3ala el taree-' , chat 20:21 3ala el-taree2 (sheet: 'on the road / way | 3ala el-6aree2' vs 'street | Shaare3'), signal prompt-then-fix. D28 is the same error as D16 (Amal quoting his 1:05:13 sentence at 1:05:47), so it is dropped as a duplicate, not as a non-error.
